metadata.title: COSU Classroom Presentation Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Classroom Presentation endpoints as shared, presentation-focused execution environments in instructional spaces.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to in-room presentation and audiovisual control for instructional delivery, with constrained functionality and shared usage.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Classroom Presentation Terminals inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint for classroom presentation and AV control.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to presentation software, approved browsers for instructional display, and audiovisual control interfaces.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Instructors authenticate per session; no persistent local user profiles are retained.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Classroom Presentation Terminals are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Endpoints are centrally enrolled, configured, and monitored.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for management integrity, monitoring, and service trust, not for user or data entitlement.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration restricts administrative tools, development environments, removable media, and unauthorized applications.

props.name: session-isolation
props.remarks: Instructor sessions are isolated and cleared at logoff or session end to prevent cross-user data exposure.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved instructional platforms, presentation sources, AV systems, and management services.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Local data storage is permitted only temporarily for presentation caching and is cleared automatically.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Classroom Presentation Terminals may only participate in workflows involving public or minimally sensitive instructional data.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: A presentation-focused COSU endpoint does not imply trust as a general workstation or eligibility for higher-classification data.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Classroom Presentation Terminals must prioritize uptime and rapid recovery to support scheduled instruction.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Endpoint health, configuration drift, and misuse attempts are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Classroom Presentation Terminals support automated session reset, periodic reimage, and auditable retirement workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Classroom Presentation Terminals implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on session isolation, limited execution scope, and instructional availability.

roles.title: Classroom Technology Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for deployment, configuration, monitoring, and recovery of Classroom Presentation Terminals.

roles.title: Instructional Technology Governance
roles.remarks: Approves presentation platforms, allowed software, and exception handling.

control-implementation.remarks: Classroom Presentation Terminal implementations are platform-specific (Windows podium builds, macOS presentation accounts, or Linux kiosk configurations) and maintained as controlled, versioned baselines.
